items.title: Crypto lending rises again… but have they solved the risks?
items.summary: Crypto lending has risen by 55% since July, but now has to deal with the dangers of AI assisted hacks, and risks cascading through interlinked protocols.

items.title: Securitize brings Apple, Nvidia and Tesla to Solana, with NYSE trading in the works
